element.hint: The Confluence connection to use for publishing — determines cloud ID, site URL, and default space key
element.label: Connection Config
element.name: connection_config

element.hint: Optional Confluence page ID used as a structural template — placeholders in the template are replaced by matching content block output or source record field values
element.label: Template Page ID
element.name: template_page_id

element.hint: A descriptive label to identify this publishing rule
element.label: Name
element.name: name

element.hint: Confluence space key where pages will be created (e.g. ENG, ITSM)
element.label: Target Space Key
element.name: target_space_key

element.hint: Template for page titles using ${field_name} placeholders from the source record
element.label: Title Template
element.name: title_template

element.hint: Confluence page ID under which new pages will be nested as children
element.label: Parent Page ID
element.name: parent_page_id

element.hint: Create = always new page, Update = only existing, Upsert = create or update
element.label: Mode
element.name: mode

element.hint: How to find an existing Confluence page for updates
element.label: Match Strategy
element.name: match_strategy

element.hint: When unchecked, this definition is disabled and will not publish
element.label: Active
element.name: active

element.hint: Filter to control which source records are eligible for publishing
element.label: Condition
element.name: condition

element.hint: Comment added to Confluence page version history on each update
element.label: Version Message Template
element.name: version_message_template

element.hint: The ServiceNow table whose records will be published to Confluence
element.label: Source Table
element.name: source_table
